description:
Job Title: .Net Developer with SharePoint experience 
 Location: Washington, DC 
 Duration: 6+Months 
 
 Interview Process: In Person required 
 
 OVERALL PURPOSE OF POSITION: 
 The purpose of this position is to provide support for critical business functions through the development, implementation, testing and maintenance of applications systems. 
 ESSENTIAL DUTIES: 
 The position’s essential duties include the following: 
 · Support critical business functions through the development, implementation, and maintenance of applications and systems; 
 · Lead and Contribute software development expertise to multiple projects and ensure that specifications are met; 
 · Design, code, test, debug, maintain, and document software applications; 
 · Follow established software development standards and procedures and contribute towards their improvement; 
 · Develop complex application features and create technical designs; 
 · Work as part of Scrum Development Team and/or as Scrum Master, effectively participate in sprint planning, task estimates, task sequencing, task assignments, sprint reviews and retrospectives 
 · Participate in peer code and design reviews; 
 · Experienced with a wide range of technologies; 
 · Coordinate with departments and users in the support of business applications. 
 · Represent the IT department in terms of software development expertise in coordination with other departments; 
 TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE 
 Type of Experience .NET/SHAREPOINT Years of Experience 
 • ASP.NET, C#, XML, .NET Framework 5+Years 
 • XHTML, JavaScript, CSS, JQuery 5+ Years 
 • Application Development/Software Engineering/Design Patterns 5+ Years 
 • T-SQL/SQL Server, RDBMS concepts and DB design 5+ Years 
 • Web application development 5+ Years 
 • MVC, Entity Framework 3+ Years 
 • Object oriented design and architecture 3+ Years 
 • Internet application development 5+ Years 
 • Object oriented design and architecture, SDLC 3+ Years 
 • Classic ASP, WebServices, TDD 5+ Years 
 • Experience with application security concepts 5+ Years 
 • Software Requirements and Specifications, QA/QC 5+ Years 
 • COTS Configuration and Implementation 3+ Years 
 • Technical Documentation 5+ Years 
 • SharePoint 2013 – 2014 development with .NET 4+ Years 
 • SharePoint Security and Architecture 3+ Years 
 • Windows Workflow Foundation development 3+ Years 
 • Relational database design and development 3+ Years 
 NOTE: In addition, please list any desired experience: 
 • Experience with agile software development such as SCRUM and XP, strongly desired. 
 • Experience with SharePoint2010 development, configuration, out-of-the-box- functionality, administration. 
 • Experience with Business Workflow Automation with SharePoint or other BPM products. 
 • Experience with PL/SQL, J2EE, SOAP, Visual Basic, AJAX, HTML5, CSS3, Dreamweaver 
 • Experience with integration of application software 
 • Experience with implementation of COTS products 
 • Experience with Serena Business Mashups or any other Serena software 
 • Experience with Microsoft Visual Studio 2010 and Team Foundation Services 
 • Experience with configuration management, release management principles 
 • TFS2012-2013 ALM 
 • BPM development in SharePoint

 .Net Developer with   SharePoint   experience
